editorialDecisions.detail: Translated42Japanese paragraphs,7lesson metadata and7question sets with7nonempty effective project readings directly from isolated canonical Japanese. Question readings independently translated because their exact wording differs from lesson cases. No other locale input.

Preserved multi-professional consultation purpose/limits, specific resident goals/observations versus profession name alone, sent/received/advice/changed-plan stages, resident speech and observed task interruptions versus unmeasured fever and unconfirmed heat cause. Specific option retains stopping towel-folding task twice, not stopping the towel itself.

Retained visible-soil soap/water, both-hand coverage/rinse/dry and rub-until-dry product limits, glove versus hygiene and recontamination, worker pain/training-capacity reporting, equipment/personal plan/team conditions, disaster supplies versus unreachable role/blocked route and assigned versus performed/effective correction.

Kept current alone-listening wish and song choice separate from future social refusal, degree of limited speech, observation versus inferred motivation, encoding/retention/recall and semantic/episodic/procedural distinctions, hearing/comprehension prerequisite checks without diagnosing from one answer. Art captions remain context-only.
